name: rolling-wave-engineering
description: Rolling-wave engineering workflow skills for shaping, preparing, implementing, delivering, finalizing, and debugging one project slice at a time.

interface.shortDescription: Build one project slice at a time
interface.longDescription: A Codex skill set for rolling-wave engineering: shape project direction, prepare one bounded review-decision slice, implement cohesive work locally or delegate when coordination pays, deliver through fresh-context finalization, accept user-declared completion from any status, and carry available learnings forward.
defaultPrompt: Use $shape-project to shape a rolling-wave project.
Use $prepare-next-slice to prepare the next slice.
Use $deliver-slice to implement and finalize the current ready slice.
